_comment: Where things physically are, in a shared robot frame. Origin: centre of
the cart's top tray at tray level; +x forward (the way the robot faces),
+y to the robot's LEFT (measured -- see lex-robot#163), +z up.
!! EVERY NUMBER BELOW IS AN ESTIMATE FROM PHOTOGRAPHS, NOT A MEASUREMENT !!
The collision model is exactly as good as these. Wrong mounting geometry
produces confident, wrong answers -- the same failure mode as an
uncalibrated CameraModel. Measure them with a ruler before relying on it.
Sanity check once measured: sidecar/probe_range.py found the arms hitting
the tower at specific shoulder_pan angles. A correct model must predict a
collision at roughly those angles -- see test_collision.py's calibration
note. That is free validation data.
